description: Updates a list of Work Items in the Global context. Scope: spans every project (no project filter). To act on a single project, use `patchWorkItems` instead. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema. Examples: {"requestBody":{"data":[{"type":"workitems","id":"myproject/WI-123","attributes":{"status":"inprogress"}}]}}. Selection: Use patchAllWorkItems for a batch spanning projects; use patchWorkItems for a batch in one project and patchWorkItem for one known item.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

name: patchAllWorkItems
